text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a research article focused primarily on biodiversity conservation priority setting and protected area expansion in China with considerations of food security. Although it excludes current and projected cropland areas to avoid conflicts, it does not perform land use land cover (LULC) future prediction or spatial simulation of LULC change. There is no implementation of ≥2 future LULC scenarios with quantitative comparison or spatial modeling accuracy metrics related to LULC prediction. The primary focus is on identifying cost-effective conservation priority areas rather than modeling or predicting LULC dynamics. Thus, it fails the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction studies.)
